input.rationale: Section 4 (p0023-p0029) addresses only term, notice and the Termination Payment; there is no transition assistance, data return/export or deletion obligation anywhere in the Agreement. Section 1.4 gives access rights only during the term, Section 8 imposes confidentiality but no return-on-termination duty, and Section 10.7 survival does not cover exit mechanics. In a hosting agreement where HDI holds the Site, our Content and user/customer data, this fails even the fallback (90 days assistance plus 30-day export). Inserted new Section 4.3 at the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter.

proposal.summary: Insert new Section 4.3 (Transition Assistance; Return of Data) after the Termination Payment provisions.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no exit mechanics, so on termination our Content, Site and customer data would remain on HDI's systems with no return or migration path. We added a Section 4.3 giving us up to six months of transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter; we can accept 90 days of assistance as a fallback.

ops.text: 4.3 Transition Assistance; Return of Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to six (6) months following the Termination Date at HDI's then-current rates, including reasonable cooperation in migrating the Site to the Company or its designee; (b) within thirty (30) days of the Company's request, return to the Company all Content, user information, customer data and other data of the Company in HDI's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Content and data from its systems and certify such deletion to the Company in writing.
